messages.subject: Genetic map creation F2 population
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to build a genetic map based on a F2 made from a cross between a plant and a wild relative. After thoroughly cleaning the data and building the linkage groups I see something weird in linkage group "L.5.1" (see the png in the attachment). Could this mean there is some duplication? Or is there something else going on?

Kind regards,

Bas

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Genetic map creation F2 population
parts:
It could be a problem with marker order. I would try to identify the blocks of linked markers in L5.1 and rearrange them to get the plot to appear more like L.1.

karl
